text.arabic_uthmani: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ

words.gloss_range: past auxiliary of being with a plural subject, locally setting a retrospective habitual predicate rather than a new command or isolated event
words.root_gloss_range: broad root range of being, occurrence, place, suretyship, and related states; the local branch is temporal predication with residual being-as-state pressure
words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) opens the ayah by carrying the already established plural group forward, so the night-vigil clause is not a detached maxim. Its perfect form governs an imperfect predicate and turns the following sleep language into a retrospective habit: their being was characterized by repeated minimal sleep. The root {{ar:ك و ن}} ({{tr:k-w-n}}) therefore works locally as auxiliary predication while still letting the line feel like a formed state of life. The repeated boundary wording from 51:16 into 51:17 makes the nocturnal conduct explain the prior excellence claim, while the scene moves from received reward into hidden human practice. The night-scarcity pattern also keeps 73:2-4 in view, and the opening plural sound is later answered by the closing plural verb.

topics.headline: plural subject continuity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah continues the same righteous group instead of introducing a detached general rule.
topics.reason: The 3mp morphology and attachment evidence keep the subject compressed and continuous with the prior discourse topic.

topics.headline: retrospective habitual frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sleep statement is a settled past pattern, not a report of one wakeful night.
topics.reason: The perfect auxiliary with an imperfect predicate is explicitly described in the bundle as a past habitual construction.

topics.headline: being as formed state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the predicate as describing a mode of life while still keeping the auxiliary function primary.
topics.reason: The root family supports being and formation language, but the local form is governed by the auxiliary construction, so the broader imagery must remain secondary.

topics.headline: boundary echo explains excellence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 51:17 as an explanation of the excellence named in 51:16 rather than a new scene.
topics.reason: The repeated state verb across 51:16 and 51:17 ties the reward/excellence statement to the nocturnal habit.

topics.headline: state tied to measured night
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that being is measured through reduced night sleep, with the night-discipline pattern of 73:2-4 in the background.
topics.reason: The local co-occurrence rows join the state verb to night and scarcity, and the cited 73:2-4 frame supports a night-practice comparison.

topics.headline: from gift to hidden practice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the movement from received reward to the private conduct that accounts for it.
topics.reason: The boundary row gives a concrete shift from the prior gift scene into unobserved nocturnal human action.

topics.headline: plural sound bracket
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening plural cadence anticipate the plural closure of the ayah.
topics.reason: The prosody row identifies a local audible bracket between the opening auxiliary and final verb.

words.gloss_range: little, scarce, or seldom in the local sleep frame; syntactically able to lean as predicate, adverbial measure, or partitive quantity
words.root_gloss_range: broad root range of fewness, smallness, summit, jars, carrying, tremor, and shaking; the local branch is fewness/scarcity, with lifting imagery only as a narrowed color
words.prose: {{ar:قَلِيلًۭا}} ({{tr:qalīlan}}) is the ayah's quantity hinge: it can describe the state framed by the opening auxiliary, measure the sleeping, or point forward into the night portion. The word therefore does more than say 'little'; it makes scarcity the grammar of the portrait. In this setting fewness becomes praise, because what is reduced is night sleep, not devotion. The root {{ar:ق ل ل}} ({{tr:q-l-l}}) is locally narrowed to fewness and small amount, while the broader lifting or lightness branch only adds a secondary sense of loosened weight. Its indefinite accusative form leaves the exact amount unfixed, and its position links 51:17 to the night-portion command field of 73:2.

topics.headline: quantity hinge in the clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the word routes the clause among state, duration, and night-portion readings.
topics.reason: The accusative adjective is licensed as adverbial, predicate-like, or partitive-linked in the local syntax.

topics.headline: fewness becomes praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that scarcity is evaluative because the minimized item is sleep.
topics.reason: The local sleep-negation frame turns a common scarcity adjective into praise for disciplined wakefulness.

topics.headline: lightness image kept secondary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can retain a lightened-wakeful color without replacing the local fewness sense.
topics.reason: V4 shows other accepted branches such as carrying and rising, but the local adjective and syntax select the fewness branch.

topics.headline: unfixed accusative measure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a quality word functioning as an unfixed measure rather than a fixed clock duration.
topics.reason: The fa'il-type qualitative adjective is indefinite accusative and can serve adverbial or predicative measurement.

topics.headline: night-portion command answered
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the commanded night portion of 73:2 appear here as achieved habitual character.
topics.reason: The rows cite the close night-portion recurrence at 73:2 and connect it to the reported habit in 51:17.

topics.headline: nasal-liquid binding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears quantity and night joined before the final sleep verb arrives.
topics.reason: The prosody rows identify liquid and nasal continuity binding the quantifier to the following partitive phrase.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking partitive selection and temporal framing; locally it binds the little amount to the night while also allowing the verb to be read inside the night domain
words.prose: {{ar:مِّنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) is the small hinge that turns bare scarcity into a night segment. It can bind the preceding quantity to the night as a partitive whole, or let the sleep verb be located within the night as its temporal domain. Because the prepositional phrase comes before the final verb, the reader hears night as the frame before sleep is named. The particle has no lexical root to expand, so the payoff is grammatical: dependency, partition, and timing are compressed into one bound word.

topics.headline: partition and time together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the preposition decides whether the phrase measures a piece of night or locates reduced sleep in night.
topics.reason: The bundle explicitly licenses both partitive and temporal readings for the prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: night frame before sleep
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that night is established before the denied or minimized sleep action appears.
topics.reason: The bound preposition governs the following night noun and precedes the final predicate.

topics.headline: audible prepositional unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the quantifier, preposition, and night noun fused into one measured unit.
topics.reason: The prosody rows describe liaison and nasal continuity across the local phrase.

words.gloss_range: the known night as genitive complement after the preposition; locally a measured devotional time-domain rather than a generic cosmic alternation
words.root_gloss_range: broad root range of night, darkness, night-oriented action, deictic night, and naming material; the local noun selects the night/darkness cycle and excludes name or byname branches
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّيْلِ}} ({{tr:al-layli}}) supplies the known night as the measured field of the clause. Its genitive form is governed by the preceding preposition, and its definiteness makes the night a familiar recurring domain rather than an unnamed stretch of time. The root {{ar:ل ي ل}} ({{tr:l-y-l}}) is narrowed here to night and darkness, not naming or byname branches, and the collective noun keeps the whole night-cycle in view. The phrase joins a Quranic night-devotion pattern with 3:113, 17:79, 39:9, 73:2, and 76:26, but 51:17 specializes that pattern by minimizing sleep; 51:18 then narrows the same temporal field forward into dawn.

topics.headline: known measured night
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees night as the measured domain of the sleep statement, not as actor or object.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, genitive, and governed by the preceding preposition in the local phrase.

topics.headline: night cycle, not name branches
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the darkness and night-cycle force while excluding unrelated naming and byname branches.
topics.reason: V4 includes several root branches, but the local noun and context select the night/darkness branch; the morphology dispute does not alter the local sense.

topics.headline: night devotion formula specialized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a recurring night-devotion frame (3:113; 17:79; 39:9; 73:2; 76:26), here specified through reduced sleep rather than a named act.
topics.reason: The rows cite night-devotion parallels including 3:113, 17:79, 39:9, 73:2, and 76:26.

topics.headline: private night refined toward dawn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reward scene move into hidden night conduct and then anticipate the dawn-time specification of 51:18.
topics.reason: The row family places the night noun after the reward scene and before the next ayah's dawn refinement.

topics.headline: definite liquid cohesion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears definiteness, quantity, and night bound by the phrase's liquid cadence.
topics.reason: The prosody rows identify article assimilation and liquid cadence linking the local phrase.

words.gloss_range: particle whose local readings include negation, expletive intensification, and nominalizing ma; the fixed surface keeps proposition-level ambiguity alive
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is the ayah's sharpest reparse point. As negation, it makes the final verb the denied habit; as an expletive intensifier after the quantity word, it yields 'little did they sleep'; as nominalizing ma, it turns the verb phrase into 'their sleeping' for the quantity to measure. The same short particle therefore keeps no sleep, little sleep, and little sleeping available without changing the written surface. Placed between the night frame and the final sleep verb, it turns time and quantity into a proposition about resisted rest, and its brief sound creates a hinge before the heavier closing verb.

topics.headline: one surface, three parses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that one unchanged particle can yield negated sleep, intensified little sleep, or a nominalized sleeping-event.
topics.reason: The bundle marks the particle function as open among negation, expletive, and nominalizing analyses.

topics.headline: scarcity becomes absence-shaped
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the portrait is built through restricted or absent sleep rather than by naming the positive act directly.
topics.reason: The particle combines with the quantity and final verb to define the behavior through limited or denied sleep.

topics.headline: brief hinge before closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a small particle hinge linking partition, polarity, and the final sleep verb.
topics.reason: The prosody rows identify the open particle and m-sound frame before the closing verb.

words.gloss_range: they sleep or enter night-rest; locally an imperfect intransitive verb under the past auxiliary, with the particle and quantity making the entry into rest minimal or denied
words.root_gloss_range: broad root range of night sleep, sleepy heedlessness, and hunger quieting; the local branch is night sleep or a sleep spell, especially early night-rest, not heedlessness or hunger-abatement
words.prose: {{ar:يَهْجَعُونَ}} ({{tr:yahjaʿūna}}) is the semantic landing of the ayah: after auxiliary, quantity, night frame, and particle, the final word names the sleep that is minimized or denied. The verb is simple Form I and intransitive, so sleep is a state they enter or resist entering, not an action done to an object. Under the opening auxiliary its imperfect form becomes repeated past habit, and the plural ending returns the same group at the close. The root {{ar:ه ج ع}} ({{tr:h-j-ʿ}}) is locally narrowed to night sleep and sleep-spell imagery, especially the onset of night-rest, which fits the night frame more sharply than a generic sleep root. Its single Quranic occurrence concentrates that rare sense here, and the heavy closing articulation gives the resisted sleep verb audible weight, while 51:16, 51:18, 73:2-4, and 17:79 show the larger movement from reward, to restrained night sleep, to wakeful devotion.

topics.headline: final target of the clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the whole preceding structure builds toward the final naming of sleep as the minimized or denied item.
topics.reason: The particle targets the final verb, and the verb completes the predicated behavior under the opening auxiliary.

topics.headline: sleep as state-entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sleep is presented as a state entered or resisted, not as an object-directed action.
topics.reason: The local verb instance is Form I intransitive with no object.

topics.headline: repeated plural habit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees repeated past habit and the same plural subject carried into the ayah's closure.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb is under the past auxiliary and shares its 3mp subject.

topics.headline: night-rest onset, not generic sleep
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the resisted item as entry into night-rest, especially the first sleep spell, rather than sleep in the most generic sense.
topics.reason: V4 supports night sleep and sleep-spell senses, while local night framing licenses the nocturnal branch and blocks heedlessness or hunger branches.

topics.headline: wakefulness as excellence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees reduced sleep as morally charged restraint that 51:18 fills with seeking forgiveness rather than mere insomnia.
topics.reason: The surrounding quantity, particle, prior excellence statement in 51:16, and forward specification in 51:18 make the sleep verb evaluative.

topics.headline: single Quranic occurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this rare sleep root carries its full Quranic burden in this one portrait.
topics.reason: The contextual profile and CRITICAL rows mark this root as a single occurrence in the corpus.

topics.headline: sleep-absence answers night devotion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees night-devotion language answered from the negative side: not by naming standing, but by naming the sleep scarcely entered (73:2-4; 17:79).
topics.reason: The rows connect the final verb to night-devotion passages such as 73:2-4 and 17:79.

topics.headline: heavy plural closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah close with the same plural group and with a weighty throat sound on the sleep verb.
topics.reason: The prosody rows identify the plural sound bracket and the heavy final articulation of the root.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction `كانوا قليلًا من الليل ما يهجعون`, with `كانوا` habitual, `قليلًا` quantitative, and `من الليل` partitive.
baseline_models.mechanism: Past temporal continuance turns a single act into a recurring nocturnal disposition, while littleness assigns sleep only a restricted share of the night.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time make the low-sleep pattern recurrent rather than episodic.
Littleness supplies the restricted quantity assigned to sleep.
Night and its darkness supply the whole temporal field from which the small share is taken.

changed_reading.before: They were generally devout at night.
changed_reading.after: Their stable habit was to allot sleep only a small fraction of each night.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The unresolved scope of `ما` after `قليلًا من الليل` and before `يهجعون`.
baseline_models.mechanism: If `ما` negates the sleep verb rather than reinforcing or nominalizing it, the little quantity can measure the interval of not sleeping; the focus then preserves the inverse allocation alongside the dominant small-sleep reading.

activation_trace.role: Temporal occurrence holds either scope choice as a repeated nightly pattern.
Littleness can quantify either sleep or, under negative scope, the no-sleep interval.
The night remains the divisible whole under both competing scope readings.

changed_reading.before: They slept during only a little of the night.
changed_reading.after: For a little of the night they did not sleep, leaving a minority-vigil reading grammatically alive.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `قليلًا` beside the rootless-inventory sleep verb `يهجعون`; no branch is fabricated for `ه ج ع`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The carrying-and-rising and oscillatory branches of `ق ل ل` turn quantity into bodily form: sleep repeatedly loses stability and gives way to getting up.

activation_trace.role: Bearing, rising, and setting out make littleness an enacted departure from sleep.
Oscillation and lack of fixedness render the sleeper repeatedly unable or unwilling to settle.
Practicing an activity by night turns the dark interval into a field of repeated action.

changed_reading.before: Little describes only how much they slept.
changed_reading.after: Little also describes the form of their night: sleep does not stay fixed, and they repeatedly rise out of it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Promise, enacted truth, and fixed occurrence recast habitual low sleep as proleptic conduct: a future certainty already occupies and reorganizes present nights.

activation_trace.role: Presence in time supplies the recurring present-night habit that the promised future can reorganize.
A promise bounded by a future time supplies the horizon toward which the nightly pattern is oriented.
Fulfillment in act converts the promised horizon from speech into dependable outcome.
Falling and becoming fixed make the future judgment read as already established.

structural_cues: 51:5-6 move from what is promised to what is true and firmly occurring before 51:17 describes the repeated night habit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a timed promise, enacted truth, fixed occurrence, and habitual `كانوا`; I infer that certainty causes future reality to govern present sleep, while the live alternative is that these are adjacent praises without a causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: They repeatedly sacrificed sleep as an isolated discipline.
changed_reading.after: They repeatedly let an assured future become present enough to claim part of every night's sleep.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding image of cognition covered by heedlessness and the later demand for inward sight turn reduced sleep into resistance to perceptual submersion, not merely reduced duration.

activation_trace.role: Instability and movement make little sleep a refusal to remain settled in unconsciousness.
Night's darkness supplies the perceptual medium in which remaining awake becomes diagnostic.
A covering of falsehood, ignorance, and distraction supplies the cognitive immersion being resisted.
Heedlessness of the heart makes ordinary sleep echo a broader failure of attention.
Insight of the heart supplies the positive perceptual capacity cultivated by wakefulness.

structural_cues: 51:11's engulfed heedlessness precedes the focus, while 51:21's question about seeing within the self follows it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cognitive covering, heart-heedlessness, little unstable sleep, and inward sight; I infer a contrastive path from less settling to more perception, while the alternative keeps physiological sleep and moral heedlessness categorically separate.

changed_reading.before: They were admirable because they slept fewer hours.
changed_reading.after: Their broken settling embodies resistance to being cognitively covered over, preserving a capacity to see.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah identifies both the terminal night interval and its action, so `من الليل` becomes an apportioned schedule: sleep is curtailed to hand the edge of night to seeking protective covering.

activation_trace.role: Littleness restricts sleep enough to expose a remaining interval for another practice.
Night-practice makes the dark period an actively managed schedule rather than empty duration.
The pre-dawn time locates the practice in a precise terminal portion of night.
The edge of a thing sharpens pre-dawn into the boundary to which curtailed sleep is handed.
Covering the fault and shielding its bearer supplies the purposeful act occupying that boundary.

structural_cues: 51:17's partitive night phrase is immediately followed by 51:18's explicit pre-dawn time phrase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a small night share, the edge-time of night, and protective forgiveness; I infer that reducing sleep creates the pre-dawn opening for that act, while the live alternative treats the two ayat as independent traits.

changed_reading.before: They accumulated a low total of sleep across the night.
changed_reading.after: They deliberately ended sleep before night's edge so that the final interval could become an act of exposed fault seeking cover.

context_deltas.mechanism: The condemned acceleration of the promised event is answered by a different urgency: the righteous do not pull the future forward but repeatedly pull themselves forward out of sleep.

activation_trace.role: Repeated temporal presence turns urgency from a demand into a durable habit.
Rising and setting out redirect motion toward the sleeper's own conduct.
Acceleration and bringing forward supply the rival form of urgency aimed at the promised event.

structural_cues: `كانوا` recurs in 51:14, 51:16, and 51:17, contrasting a former habit of hastening with habits of doing good and little sleep.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies condemned hastening, repeated `كانوا`, and a rising branch within `قليلًا`; I infer that urgency is redirected from forcing the event's time to advancing one's own response, while the alternative is only a contrast between unrelated group descriptions.

changed_reading.after: Little sleep expresses disciplined urgency: they advance themselves out of rest without demanding that the promised future be advanced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from taking what is given, through private restriction of sleep and pre-dawn self-exposure, to recognizing an enforceable share in wealth; nocturnal restraint becomes a hinge between reception and release.

activation_trace.role: Chosen littleness supplies a private pattern of taking less for oneself.
Taking possession supplies the receptive side of the ethical circuit.
Giving identifies what is possessed as received rather than self-originating.
Accumulated wealth supplies the material that must pass beyond private possession.
A fixed, obligatory entitlement turns generosity into a due transfer.
Request and seeking identify one visible claimant on the received wealth.
Deprivation and missing the desired good identify the claimant who cannot voice a request.

structural_cues: 51:16 receiving, 51:17 restricting sleep, 51:18 seeking forgiveness, and 51:19 assigning a right form an uninterrupted ethical sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies received gift, little sleep, an owed right, a requester, and a deprived person; I infer that voluntary private restriction trains release of received wealth, while the live alternative treats nocturnal practice and material justice as parallel but causally independent virtues.

changed_reading.before: Little sleep is a private ascetic achievement.
changed_reading.after: Little sleep is the interior restraint between receiving a gift and releasing part of it as another person's fixed right.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence of carrying a burden and dividing shares activates both the rising-bearing branch of `ق ل ل` and the partitive grammar of `من الليل`: sleep is a measured allotment within a night borne until one rises.

activation_trace.role: Bearing, lifting, and rising let `قليلًا` describe emergence from a load as well as small quantity.
Littleness keeps the sleep allotment quantitatively anchored while the material analogy develops.
Lifting a visible load activates the bearing-and-rising potential already present in `قليلًا`.
A heavy burden supplies the weight-like resistance of night and sleep.
Separating and distributing a share makes the little sleep a deliberate allotment from the larger night.

structural_cues: 51:1-4 progress through scattering, carrying, easy movement, and apportioning; 51:17 later contains a partitive night phrase and a sleep verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burden-bearing, heavy load, apportioned shares, `قليلًا`'s rising branch, and `من الليل`; I infer that the opening material sequence patterns the sleeper's night as load, allotment, and rising, while the alternative confines those opening images to their immediate oath sequence.

changed_reading.before: Night is a neutral container and little sleep is merely counted within it.
changed_reading.after: Night becomes a load borne and divided, with sleep receiving a small share before the sleeper rises from its weight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant `و ع د` mapping to swimming, a water-submersion branch of `غ م ر`, and a dawn-opening branch under contextual `ن ف س`. It remains anchored in the focus through `ق ل ل`'s oscillatory instability, explicit night, and the sleep construction. Render only as a cross-domain material analogy, never as the lexical gloss of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sleeper's unstable `قليلًا`, the encompassing `الليل`, and the uncited structural sleep verb permit a night-crossing image without assigning `ه ج ع` an absent branch.

activation_trace.role: Oscillation and lack of fixedness keep the sleeper figuratively moving rather than sinking into settled sleep.
Dark night supplies the expanse through which the figurative crossing occurs.
The non-dominant swimming and flowing branch supplies the motion of staying afloat.
Overwhelming, covering water supplies the danger of submersion that wakefulness resists.
The opening or breathing of dawn supplies the far bank toward which the night crossing moves.

changed_reading.before: They simply remained awake for much of the night.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their unstable sleep keeps consciousness afloat through an engulfing night until dawn opens and breathes.

strongest_changes: The future promise becomes present enough to reorganize recurring nights.
Low sleep becomes resistance to cognitive immersion and a condition for inward sight.
The partitive night resolves into a deliberate handoff from sleep to pre-dawn forgiveness.
Private restriction becomes a hinge between received gift and another person's fixed material right.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports opposite `ما` scope readings, while `ق ل ل` contributes not only scarcity but rising and instability. Context then activates temporal, perceptual, distributive, and material mechanisms without resolving them into one interpretation; the absent `ه ج ع` inventory is never fabricated.
remaining_uncertainties: The scope of `ما` leaves minority-sleep and minority-vigil allocations coexisting.
The causal arrows from sequence to nocturnal practice are reader-supplied and could instead mark parallel virtues or contrasts.
The load, rising, and swimming models depend on branch-distant material analogy and require explicit exploratory qualification.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Night sleep is deliberately kept to a small measure.** `ق ل ل/B001` supplies fewness, `ل ي ل/B001` night, and `ه ج ع/B001` a light or early-night sleep spell. The following predawn seeking (51:18) makes reduced sleep a temporal preparation. I infer **limited sleep -> wakeful access to predawn practice**. The line reads as calibrated rhythm rather than generalized sleeplessness.
2. **Heedlessness is what becomes little.** `ه ج ع/B002` supplies sleepy foolish heedlessness, activated retrospectively by `س ه و/B001` in 51:11. I infer **ethical vigilance -> little participation in heedless yielding**. This exploratory reading remains anchored in *yahjaʿūn* and does not replace literal sleep.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:55's beneficial reminder reinforced the exploratory heedlessness branch: their reduced *hujūʿ* is part of sustained receptivity, not sleep deprivation alone.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Temporal scarcity creates usable moral surplus.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ق ل ل/B001` is “fewness and smallness”; `ل ي ل/B001` is night and its darkness; `ه ج ع/B001` is “night sleep and a light sleep spell.” **Structural cue:** the ayah follows receiving and prior beneficence (51:16), then immediately opens into predawn forgiveness (51:18), social right (51:19), earth-signs, self-sight, and sky-provision (51:20–22). **Role and abduction:** fewness restricts sleep, making time available at the dark-to-dawn threshold; I infer that this released interval enables the attention and outward redistribution named next. **Reading change:** little sleep reads as deliberate reallocation of a finite temporal resource, not ascetic deprivation detached from the surrounding practices.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 51:18–19 showed where the released night-time goes: first into seeking forgiveness and then into recognizing another’s claim, making scarcity productive rather than merely restrictive.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir biçimin kadın adı olduğunu ve bu adı içeren ayrı bir söz öbeğinin şarabı örtülü biçimde anlattığını doğrular. Dal bir adlandırma kümesi olarak korunabilir; ancak kadın adının kendi başına şarap anlamına geldiği sanılmamalı, şarap anlamı yalnız tam söz öbeğine bağlanmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kadın adı temel adlandırma kullanımıdır; şarap anlamı yalnız ayrı ve tam bir söz öbeğinin örtülü ad işlevine aittir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız ad olarak kullanılan biçimi ve şarabı anan tam söz öbeğini kapsar; bunlar genel gece veya karanlık anlamına genişletilemez.

concept_map.definition: Bir biçimin kadın adı olarak kullanılmasıdır; aynı adı içeren ayrı bir söz öbeği ise şarabı anan örtülü bir ad işlevi görür. İki kullanım aynı dalda bulunsa da kadın adı ile içki anlamı birbirine eşit değildir.

facets.statement: Söz konusu biçim bir kadını adlandıran kişi adı olarak kullanılır.
Bu adı içeren ayrı bir söz öbeği, şarabı doğrudan söylemeden anan örtülü bir ad olarak kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt kadın adı kullanımını ortak biçimde destekler ve ayrıca bu adı içeren tam bir söz öbeğinin şarabı örten bir ad olduğunu bildirir. İkinci kullanım bağımsız söz öbeğine bağlı tutulmalıdır.

concept_gloss.text: bir kadın adı; ayrıca belirli bir söz öbeğinde şarabın örtülü adı
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın kişi adı çekirdeğini ve yalnız tam söz öbeğine bağlı şarap adlandırmasını sınırlarıyla birlikte açıklar.

error_profile.preserves: Kadın adı ile söz öbeğine bağlı örtülü şarap adını ayrı tutarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Biçimin bir kadını adlandırdığı kişi adı kullanımında geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Biçimin kadın kişi adı olma işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız kadın adını içeren tam söz öbeğinin şarabı dolaylı biçimde andığı kullanımda geçerlidir.

error_profile.preserves: Tam söz öbeğinin şarabı örterek adlandırma işlevini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir kadın adını ve ayrı bir söz öbeğinde şarabın örtülü adını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gece zamanını ve gece karanlığını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: adlandırma ile gece anlamı arasındaki ayrım
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Dallar aynı biçim ailesiyle bağlantılıdır, fakat yalnız tarihsel ve biçimsel bir çağrışım paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın anlamı kişi ve içki adlandırmasıdır; komşu dal ise bir zaman bölümünü ve karanlığı gösterir, dolayısıyla iki dal olağan kullanımda birbirinin yerine geçmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Farklı bir kadın adını ve bu adı içeren örtülü şarap sözünü kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Başka ve ayrı bir kadın adını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: iki ayrı kadın adının anlam alanı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir biçimin kadın kişi adı olarak kullanılmasını tanıklar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Adlandırma işlevleri aynı alandadır, fakat adların kimlikleri ayrıdır; ayrıca bu dalda belirli bir söz öbeğine bağlı şarap kullanımı bulunur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir kadın adı ile ona bağlı örtülü şarap sözünü içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Başka biçimlerin erkek adı, kadın adı veya lakap olarak kullanılmasını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: ayrı kişi adları ve lakaplar alanı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da sözlük biçimlerinin kişi adı olarak aktarılmasını konu eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortak alan adlandırmadır; ancak gösterilen adlar farklıdır ve komşu dalın erkek adı ile lakap kapsamı bu dalda bulunmaz, bu dalın şarap söz öbeği de komşuda yoktur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel gece dalı ile iki ayrı kişi adı dalı, adlandırma işlevini biçimsel yakınlıktan ve farklı ad kimliklerinden ayırmak için seçildi.
